diablo.height: Seedlings 6-8 ft, clones 5-6 ft; two phenos: 5-8 ft and 3-4 ft. Stretches a lot
diablo.yield: Over a pound per plant outdoors
diablo.blurb: Purple Vancouver Island outdoor strain with sativa structure and dense buds. 2nd place Outdoor, 2002 BC Harvest Cup. Top outdoors; two phenos taste the same.

wmhp.height: Big stretch. Flip at 6-10 in for a ~5 ft plant
wmhp.aroma: Tea, spice, watermelon in the last 1-2 weeks; some phenos garlic-citrus, woody or chocolate
wmhp.grow: Light feeder, short veg. About 1000 PPFD in flower; Metal Halide preferred, white LED works.
wmhp.blurb: Mass Medical open pollination of Bodhi's Himalayan collection. Little leaf, foxtails, mold resistant; many phenos turn purple late.

crazyhazey.blurb: Holy Roller mother (Big Sur x Face Off BX1) with Moonbow #75 reversal pollen. Faster finishing than a typical Haze; most phenos smell kushy rather than sativa.

circlejerk.notes: Expect basically a Moonbow x Runtz cross.
circlejerk.grow: Early veg: 70-75F, light 25% (<20 PAR), VPD 0.7, nitrogen sensitive (CalMag, light N). Veg: 80F, light 100% (25-30 PAR), VPD 1.2-1.5, feed heavy (Groganica set).

sourtrop.aroma: Sour lime, orange, cookie dough; lemon-lime, spicy orange, tangerine, peppery diesel
sourtrop.blurb: Oni Seed Co. Sour phenos run longer with above-average yield; mixed phenos go dark purple.

lemonheads2.aroma: Deep fuely, chemmy kush, lemon peel, cleaner
lemonheads2.blurb: One standout from DogWalker x Lemon Peel (Hawaii reversal), crossed to a Planet Purple F2 male. Huge bracts and dense resin, too greasy to wash.

bingo.aroma: Purple Indica fragrance: lavender, floral, plum
bingo.blurb: Zilla (Purple Indica x Skunk/Haze) x Oishii. Dark purple buds with pure Purple Indica terps, better potency and a 60-day finish.

ichiban.height: Tall, stretchy; low calyx-to-leaf ratio in some
ichiban.aroma: Earthy, dank eucalyptus-oil funk with candy
ichiban.blurb: Toad Venom (Becky) x Oishii. Tall slender colas of golf-ball nugs; Oishii adds dank and Z-dominant flavor.

mb112ix.grow: Early veg: 70-75F, light 25% (<20 PAR), VPD 0.7, nitrogen sensitive (CalMag, light N). Veg: 80F, light 100% (25-30 PAR), VPD 1.2-1.5, feed heavy (Groganica set). (Zkittles-family guidance.)
mb112ix.blurb: Closest seed version of the Moonbow #112 clone. Sticky resin; 4-5% washers, mostly a flower-quality line.

dreammachine.height: Large frame, stretches and fills in; hybrid vigor, massive bracts
dreammachine.aroma: Skunky Christmas wreath, pine sol, electric citrus
dreammachine.blurb: (Albert Walker x Zkittles #5) x Planet Purple F2. Phenos range from 80s pine wreath to Zkittles push-pop incense; described as a "dream state" high.

oishii.blurb: Archive Flavor Pack selection crossed to Moonbow males. Essentially a Moonbow backcross; "oishii" means delicious in Japanese.

biscotti.seed: Female seeds (bag seed from Dan Dosik)
biscotti.height: Indoor 31-46 in; outdoor up to 10 ft
biscotti.aroma: Vanilla, honey, coffee, earthy diesel; caryophyllene dominant
biscotti.blurb: Gelato #25 x Sour Florida OG, bred by Cookies Fam (Jai Ching). Short bushy plant, dark olive buds with purple streaks.

goldenputang.height: About 3x stretch; vigorous first 28 days of flower
goldenputang.aroma: Pineapple, deep sour orange, skunky hazy gas
goldenputang.blurb: Mass Medical x Green Bodhi collab with gooey resin. Takes topping well; flower smaller than other strains.

laos.potency: THC 10%, THCV 1.5%, trace CBC and CBG; terpenes 1.08%
laos.aroma: Myrcene, caryophyllene, humulene dominant; some phenos pinene and limonene
laos.blurb: Collected by Bodhi, increased by Khalifa Genetics, open-pollinated by Mass Medical (30+ plants). Very large seeds.

valedictorian.aroma: Pineapple-mushroom pheno; creamy vanilla; Star Pupil funk
valedictorian.blurb: Mass Medical 2019 freebie (Star Pupil x Weapon X); a purple gene pool with varied phenos.

medipak.type: Sativa; some phenos THC:CBD about 1:1, with THCV
medipak.blurb: Medi Haze x Swabi Pakistani. Very frosty sativa bred to stay psychoactive with CBD present.

moneytree.notes: Reports back: "best smelling weed". Uplifting in small amounts. Bonsai grow 2022-23.
moneytree.blurb: F1 of 3Thirteen GG4 cut x TGA Jilly Bean.

icyog.height: Minimal stretch with Icy Grape-leaning plants; decent stretch with Ancient OG-leaning
icyog.aroma: Icy Grape: sweet grape, grape wine. Ancient OG: floral, sugary
icyog.notes: Cull short, thick phenos in wet, humid areas. Look for tall, thin Christmas-tree plants outdoors.
icyog.blurb: Copa Genetics. Icy Grape (75% indica) x Ancient OG F2 purple-stem males.

bluetuna.notes: Loves the smell. Crossed with a male of itself; scent and leaf color still great.
bluetuna.blurb: Blue Dream cut x Tuna male (Hazeman Seeds). Needs room; mold and mite resistant.

fishsticks.notes: Seeds harvested Sept 2022. Planned pollen crosses failed; the Icy OG female made late stress pollen that took on Blue Tuna (still foxtailing). Blue Tuna was topped twice with LST: densest node spacing seen.

bubblepak.notes: Bubble Gum seed from an old bag (Alex Fedorov, ~2018-20). Germinated Jul 8 2022, female by Jul 22, flipped 12/12 Sep 9, pollinated Oct 5 with colloidal-silver Medi Pak pollen, seeds harvested Dec 28 2022.

goldfish.blurb: Hazeman Seeds. Rock-hard black-to-golden buds; Kodiak Gold adds mold resistance. High potency, may be too much for beginners.

cherrywinef2.potency: CBD up to 12-14%, THC under 0.3% if harvested early Oct outdoors or day 45 indoors

scbigbud.blurb: First COPA "American Heirlooms" release: Mendocino beans via THCVhunter, 1,082 beans.

wgauto.grow: LST helps light and airflow; feed with good nutrients; flush in the last weeks.
wgauto.blurb: Easy beginner grow with a purple tint and icing-like resin.

meigsog.notes: Copa Genetics documents it poorly; that is all that is known.

gg4i95chem.notes: Beans from Dan. Not grown yet.

zwoosh.aroma: Tropical candy funk, rare potpourri skunk
zwoosh.blurb: Fast-flowering Zkittlez-dominant regular cross from the Oishii line. Suits multi-tier LED grows; longer-flowering plants are easier and yield better.

tahitilime.aroma: Tropical lime fruit, skunky Moonbow side, fuel-like terps from Lemon Lime Line
tahitilime.blurb: Tart citrus hybrid; breeder notes describe potent, relaxing effects with a creative stone.

toadvenom.blurb: Keeper plant originally called Becky, selected from a Ronin Seeds cross of about 30 seeds grown at Green Dragon (North Hollywood).
toadvenom.conflict: Sources list Animal Face x Sin Mintz (Ronin Seeds), not Animal Mintz x Sin Mint; Sin Mintz reported as SinMint Cookies x Zkittlez

moonbow.aroma: Berry, fruity, orange, sweet; limonene, ocimene, terpinolene, valencene
moonbow.blurb: Archive Seed Bank cross of Zkittlez and Do-Si-Dos.

dosidos.flower: 8-10 weeks indoors; late Sep to early Oct outdoors
dosidos.yield: not a very high-yield plant (per many sites)
dosidos.aroma: Fruity, skunky; mint, citrus, earthy. Limonene, myrcene, linalool
dosidos.blurb: Relaxing yet cerebral and social hybrid with Girl Scout Cookies lineage, bred by Archive Seed Bank around 2016.

faceoff.flower: 7-9 weeks indoors; late Sep to mid Oct outdoors
faceoff.potency: THC reported 18-30% (varies by source), CBD low (<1%)
faceoff.aroma: Earthy, pine, diesel/gas; limonene, myrcene, humulene
faceoff.blurb: OG Kush descendant; Archive backcrosses of it helped produce Do-Si-Dos and Oregon Lemons.

gsc.aroma: Sweet, earthy, cookie flavor; skunky, minty aroma
gsc.blurb: Potent, award-winning favorite; commonly described as OG Kush x Durban Poison, though breeder Jigga called such origin stories unconfirmed.

ogkush.aroma: Pungent, earthy, woodsy; spicy, citrusy taste
ogkush.blurb: Dense, frosty buds with a mixed cerebral and couchlock high. Considered difficult to grow (prone to mildew, pests).
ogkush.conflict: Cannigma says often described as Chemdawg x Hindu Kush landrace; origin uncertain with competing stories

zkittlez.aroma: Fruity, candy-like; 2014 Emerald Cup note of tangerine juice and tequila with lime
zkittlez.blurb: Potent candy-flavored hybrid bred by 3rd Gen Family and Terp Hogz; Grape Ape x Grapefruit plus an unknown third parent.

sunsetsherbet.aroma: Sweet, fruity, earthy; berries to creamy mint
sunsetsherbet.blurb: Fruity, frosty hybrid from Sherbinskis with a relaxing, euphoric full-body high. Founder says it came from an accidental 2014 pollination.

ghostog.blurb: Described as a cut/elite phenotype of OG Kush with crystal-covered buds and strong citrus smell.

dogwalker.aroma: Skunky, diesel/fuel; pine, earthy kush, hint of citrus
dogwalker.conflict: Most sources list Albert Walker x Chemdawg 91 (unconfirmed by a primary source)

pinkpanties.blurb: Repeatedly cited as a parent of Sunset Sherbert and later Gelato-era genetics.
pinkpanties.conflict: Sources cite Burmese Kush x Florida Kush backcross, so not a true unknown founder

hpk.blurb: Pure Kush selection; height, flowering time and yield vary by cut or seed release.

gelato25.aroma: Sweet, fruity sherbet with minty cookie notes; orange zest
gelato25.blurb: A phenotype selection of the Gelato cross of Sunset Sherbet and Thin Mint GSC.

weddingcake.aroma: Vanilla cake frosting; caryophyllene, limonene, myrcene
weddingcake.blurb: Hybrid bred by Seed Junky Genetics, named for its vanilla frosting aroma.
weddingcake.conflict: Most sources list Triangle Kush x Animal Mints; one guide says Cherry Pie x GSC.

cherrywine.potency: CBD-dominant, THC under 0.3% on hemp flower listings; male parent tested no detectable THC
cherrywine.blurb: CBD-focused cross of The Wife and Charlotte's Cherries.
cherrywine.conflict: Seedfinder credits Bodhi Urban of Kaya Creations (2015) under the Tree of Life label.

charcherries.blurb: CBD cut; Seedfinder says it is Charlotte's Web (R4) x Colorado Cherry.
charcherries.conflict: Existing cross says parents not found; Seedfinder lists Charlotte's Web (R4) x Colorado Cherry.

thewife.blurb: CBD-rich hybrid of undisclosed genetics; Seedfinder credits it to 303 Seeds.

kodiakgold.blurb: Gold and lavender phenos reported by forum growers; Seedfinder credits Scott Family Farms.
kodiakgold.conflict: Forums credit Reeferman; Seedfinder and JointCommerce credit Scott Family Farms. Flower 53 days vs 8-9 weeks.

blacktuna.blurb: Cross of Herijuana and Lamb's Bread by 5 Star Organic; named for the Black Tuna Gang.

herijuana.blurb: Leafly lists it as an indica with mostly calming effects.

lambsbread.blurb: Sativa of unknown genetic origin with light green buds.

sourdiesel.blurb: Parentage varies by source: Chemdawg x Super Skunk, or Original Diesel based crosses.
sourdiesel.conflict: Sources conflict on parents (Chemdawg x Super Skunk, Original Diesel x NL/Shiva/Hawaiian); no DNL source found.

origdiesel.blurb: Seedfinder genealogy traces it to Chemdawg and a Mass Super Skunk x Sensi NL hybrid; origin listed as unknown or legendary.

tropcookies.blurb: GSC (Forum cut) x Tangie by Oni Seed Co.
tropcookies.conflict: One source says Tropicana Punch x GSC.

tangie.blurb: DNA Genetics cross of California Orange and Skunk #1; very resinous with a tangerine aroma.

bestshitever.type: indica-dominant (70/30 per Allbud for Cross of the Titans)
bestshitever.blurb: Green Bodhi strain; used as a parent of Cross of the Titans.

clashtitans.blurb: Listed as Cross of the Titans: Best Shit Ever x (Medusa x Pegasus), bred by 42.
clashtitans.conflict: Allbud lists Best Shit Ever x (Medusa x Pegasus), not just Medusa x Pegasus.

bshw.blurb: Obscure genetics, rumored Mexican sativa and Mazar i Sharif; purple/pink buds with indica structure.

albertwalker.aroma: Skunk, lemon, pungent; myrcene, caryophyllene, pinene
albertwalker.blurb: Rare Pacific Northwest clone-only cultivar; difficult to grow, heavy feeder.
albertwalker.conflict: Lineage unknown per Weedmaps; Leafly suggests Afghan Skunk or African Skunk descent.

sourflorida.blurb: Florida OG; stretches to double its height in early flower.
sourflorida.conflict: Most sources say Chemdawg x Lemon Thai x Hindu Kush rather than an OG Kush cut.

superruntz.aroma: Sweet candy, citrus, tropical fruit, creamy gas

sinmint.blurb: Sin City Seeds cross of Blue Power and Forum Cut GSC.
sinmint.conflict: Existing says parents not listed; sources agree Blue Power x Forum Cut GSC.

animalmintz.blurb: Seed Junky Genetics hybrid with a tart menthol aroma.
animalmintz.conflict: Parentage disputed: Animal Cookies x SinMint, or GSC x Blue Power.

mendobreath.aroma: Sweet, dessert-like; vanilla, caramel, earthy pine
mendobreath.blurb: Gage Green Genetics cross of OG Kush Breath and Mendo Montage from Mendocino, CA. Work on the line began in 2012.

pegasus.blurb: Gage Green cross of Grateful Breath with a Purple Elephant x (Grape Stomper x Aloha White Widow) line. Never sold as feminized seed.

gg4.blurb: Resin-covered buds with pungent earthy and sour aromas. Renamed Original Glue after a 2017 settlement with the adhesive maker.

gorillabutter.aroma: Sweet, nutty, creamy with earthy garlic and gas notes
gorillabutter.blurb: Cross of GG4 and Peanut Butter Breath; nutty flavor from the PBB side, diesel from GG4.

pbb.potency: THC ~20% (Leafly); tested up to 28% in seed listing
pbb.aroma: Nutty, buttery, chestnut; spicy, earthy, sweet
pbb.blurb: ThugPug Genetics cross of DoSiDos with Gage Green Mendo Breath F2. Main terpenes limonene, caryophyllene, linalool.

whitetruffle.blurb: BeLeaf says it hunted and named this phenotype of Gorilla Butter. Fresh Coast Seed Co. is also credited with developing it.
whitetruffle.conflict: Seedfinder tree shows Gorilla Butter F2 x Gorilla Butter F2; a Leafly page calls ancestry unclear

grapestomper.blurb: Usually attributed to Gage Green: Purple Elephant x Elite Chemdawg Sour Diesel. Also sold as Sour Grapes.
grapestomper.conflict: Elite Chemdawg may have been a Headband cut; one seed listing says Grape Ape x Sour Diesel x Chemdog; Purple Elephant given as Purple Urkle x Hashplant

purplepunch.blurb: Cross of Larry OG and Granddaddy Purple per Leafly. Breeder credit disputed.

icygrape.blurb: Copa Genetics cross with Black Domina 1996 (Sensi Seeds) as one parent. Never available as feminized seed.
icygrape.conflict: One review gives Purple Zkittlez (SMMJ cut) x Black Domina 1996; Seedfinder gives (Original Z x Purple Punch) x Black Domina 1996

ancientog.blurb: Bodhi Seeds cross of an Iranian landrace and Snow Lotus male. Never available as feminized seed.

chemdog.blurb: Origin story: 1991 Grateful Dead show bag seed, one of 13 seeds became Chem 91. Location and details vary by account.

bigbud.blurb: Known for high yields and massive buds with few leaves; suited to SOG. Leafly lists Afghani, Northern Lights and Skunk #1 genetics.

i95.blurb: Top Dawg cut by Money Mike (JJNYC also credited), reported as Triangle Kush x (Legend OG x Stardawg IX2).
i95.conflict: Leafly and Leaf Magazine state Triangle Kush x (Legend OG x Stardawg IX2); existing text says parents unconfirmed

putang.blurb: Intense hybrid with a strong mental high and heavy body buzz. Buds are mostly purple, some phenotypes green with purple streaks.

starpupil.height: Medium stretch, roughly doubles at flower onset
starpupil.aroma: Perfume, grape, heavy, skunky, purple character
starpupil.blurb: Feminized-only, purple-flowering strain that is stable and stress-resistant. Buds stay purple from the start of flowering.

swabi.height: Tall lanky sativa and short squat indica phenotypes
swabi.yield: Can yield very well with large colas
swabi.potency: Some phenos about 20% THC, some up to 13% CBD
swabi.aroma: Varies by mother: sour vinegar, pine, rubber, spice, garlic; curry-spice stems
swabi.blurb: Unhybridized landrace from the Swabi region of Pakistan, from a farmer who grew it for over 40 years. Released 2020 via Breeders Without Borders.

medihaze.blurb: CBD-enriched Haze cross; 2nd place CBD Flowers at Emerald Cup 2019.
medihaze.conflict: SeedFinder lists CBD MediHaze under CBD Crew, not Mass Medical; parents Super Silver Haze x Neville's Haze x unknown CBD-rich strain

iran.flower: About 60 days listed; text says 2 to 4 months
iran.potency: More THC than CBD, no percentage given
iran.aroma: Varies by plant: dank to candy, garlic to lemon, honey to foul socks
iran.blurb: Wide-ranging landrace collected around Iran by The Landrace Team. Very resinous and variable in structure; regular seeds only.

snowlotus.aroma: Chemical, ammonia, woody; earthy with hint of lemon
snowlotus.blurb: Bodhi Seeds strain, also known as Goohead. Energizing, creative, euphoric effects.
snowlotus.conflict: Leafly lists parents as Afgooey female x Blockhead male, so not a landrace founder

weaponx.conflict: AllBud lists Weapon X as Race Fuel OG x Bitch Slap; no source found for Mendo Purps x Pakistani

mendopurps.blurb: From Mendocino County, California; clone-only until BC Bud Depot made a stable seed cross. Leaves turn purple as it ripens.

c99.blurb: Bred by Mr. Soul of Brothers Grimm from seeds found in a Jack Herer package. Known for high yields, short bushy stature and short flowering time.
c99.conflict: Leafly lists parents as Jack Herer x Shiva Skunk, so not an unknown founder

whitewidow.blurb: Bred by Green House Seeds in the Netherlands in the 1990s from a Brazilian sativa and a South Indian indica.
whitewidow.conflict: Leafly lists parents as Brazilian sativa landrace x South Indian indica, so not an unknown founder

bluedream.aroma: Sweet berry, blueberry; myrcene, pinene, caryophyllene
bluedream.blurb: Balanced hybrid from California with cerebral stimulation and body relaxation. Cross of Blueberry and Haze.

blueberry.blurb: Also called Berry Blue; won High Times Cannabis Cup 2000 for Best Indica. Calming with long-lasting euphoria.
blueberry.conflict: Leafly gives Purple Thai x Thai in text and Afghani x Thai in genetics; not Temple Flo x HTAF

templeflo.blurb: Remade from DJ Short's Floral Line as a version of the original 1995 Flo; Purple Thai x Afghani, possibly a backcross.

haze.blurb: Originated in Santa Cruz, California in the 1960s per Leafly; energizing and creative, used to breed many hybrids.
haze.conflict: Leafly lists Thai and South American as parents; a reader disputes this, so lineage uncertain

tunakush.aroma: Skunk, pungent, tar, fuel with subtle sweetness
tunakush.blurb: British Columbia strain with small, dense, resin-heavy nuggets and modest yield.
tunakush.conflict: Leafly lists Hindu Kush as parent

jillybean.blurb: TGA Subcool cross of Orange Velvet and Space Queen. Uplifting, euphoric and energetic.

orangevelvet.blurb: Created by MzJill Genetics; energizing effects. Mostly discontinued.
orangevelvet.conflict: Leafly lists Skunk 1 as parent, so not a true founder

spacequeen.blurb: Hybrid made by crossing Romulan and Cinderella 99 with a buzzy head high.

romulan.blurb: Intense cerebral effects that give way to sedation; dense, frosty buds.
romulan.conflict: Leafly lists parents as North American Indica x White Rhino, so not an unknown founder

bubblegum.blurb: Bred by growers in Indiana; body-numbing high that eases pain while leaving the mind somewhat alert.
